mapper.select: SELECT address_id, member_id, address_name, receiver_name, receiver_phone, postal_code, address, address_detail, is_default FROM ADDRESS WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, address_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ADDRESS SET is_default = 1 WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY address_id DESC LIMIT 1
UPDATE ADDRESS SET is_default = 0 WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_default = 1
